blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We push the frontier of large-scale spatial intelligence in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and introduce the first benchmark that probes geographical layout understanding from real-world videos, spanning up to 1km distances. Inspired by the cognitive science literature, we evaluate models against the hierarchical stages of human spatial awareness: anchoring via landmarks, connecting them through routes, and integrating these into global mental maps. Extensive experiments reveal a fundamental divergence in how current AI models process spatial information. Instead of utilising true path integration or forming geometric survey knowledge, we find that VLMs rely almost entirely on 2D visual recognition and text-matching to bypass complex spatial reasoning. The benchmark is publicly available at https://perception-test-challenge.github.io/kilometervision.html .
blocks.zh: 我们推进视野-语言模型(VLMs)中大规模空间智能的前沿,并引入第一个从现实世界视频中探寻地理布局理解的基准,其跨度高达1公里. 在认知科学文献的启发下,我们对照人类空间意识的分级阶段评价模型:通过地标定位,通过路线连接,并将这些模型纳入全球精神地图. 广泛的实验揭示了当前AI模型如何处理空间信息的根本分歧. 我们发现VLM没有利用真正的路径集成或形成几何测量知识,而是几乎完全依靠2D视觉识别和文本匹配来绕过复杂的空间推理. 该基准可在https://deguise-test-challenge.github.io/kilimerovision.html上公开查阅。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : KilometerVision – the first benchmark probing city-scale spatial understanding from real-world videos spanning 1km distances. Left: Real-world hour-long video of a walking tour in Istanbul and relevant questions one would ask when visiting an unfamiliar place. Centre: Grounding the video on the map instantly reveals loop closures, distances between landmarks, or sequences of streets visited. Right: Using the landmark-route-map paradigm from cognitive science, we define tasks to comprehensively evaluate visual city-scale spatial intelligence in video-language models.
blocks.zh: 图1 : Kilometer Vision – 第一个从1千米距离的真实世界视频中测试城市规模空间理解的基准. 左:真实世界一小时的视频, 中点 : 将影片放置在地图上, 对: 利用认知科学的标志性-路由-地图范式,我们定义任务,在视频语言模型中全面评价视觉城市尺度空间智能.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Spatial intelligence is a hallmark of general intelligence [ 16 ] . Species across the animal kingdom develop tailored spatial representations, intrinsically linked to their dominant sensory modalities, enabling them to recognise places, plan paths, and navigate, sometimes across thousands of kilometres [ 2 , 19 , 1 ] . For example, birds rely on geomagnetic fields for orientation, insect-eating bats use echolocation to extract depth, and humans leverage visual and proprioception senses to form mental maps of their environments [ 45 , 46 , 59 ] . Given that current large vision-language models (VLMs) are primarily trained on passive internet-scale data, how do they represent their surroundings?
blocks.zh: 空间情报是一般情报的标志[16]. 整个动物王国的物种发展出量体裁衣的空间表示方式,与它们占主导地位的感官模式有着内在的联系,使它们能够识别地点、规划路径和导航,有时跨越数千公里[2、19、1]。 例如,鸟类依赖地磁场进行定向,食虫蝙蝠使用回声定位来提取深度,人类利用视觉感和自主感来形成其环境的精神图[45,46,59]. 鉴于目前的大型视觉语言模型(VLMs)主要接受被动互联网尺度数据的培训,这些模型如何代表其周围环境?

blocks.en: Multiple works have addressed this question in small-scale environments, studying how VLMs represent objects and their relations [ 41 , 40 ] . Navigation and planning capabilities have also been studied in simulated interactive environments or factory-like settings [ 47 , 64 , 31 , 41 ] . In this work, we push the envelope to city scale and explore if VLMs can infer valid geographic spatial representations from real-world videos of hour-long walking tours.
blocks.zh: 多项著作在小规模环境中处理了这一问题,研究了VLM如何代表物体及其关系[41,40]. 导航和规划能力也在模拟互动环境或类似工厂的设置中进行了研究[47、64、31、41]。 在这部作品中,我们把信封推向城市规模,并探索VLMs能否推断出真实世界中长达一小时的步行旅行视频中有效的地理空间表现.

blocks.en: We present KilometerVision , the first benchmark to comprehensively assess VLMs’ city-scale spatial intelligence from real-world videos. We take inspiration from the landmarks-route-map paradigm from the large-scale spatial cognitive literature [ 45 , 10 , 26 ] and define tasks in multiple-choice video QA format to comprehensively evaluate the existence of these three types of spatial constructs: landmarks (ability to identify and localise salient objects), routes (egocentric turn-by-turn representations linking two locations), and survey knowledge (allocentric maps integrating multiple routes) [ 51 ] ; see Fig. 1 (right).
blocks.zh: 我们提出Kilometer Visions, 这是第一个从真实世界视频中全面评估城市空间情报的基准。 我们从大型空间认知文献[45、10、26]的地标-路由图范式中汲取灵感,并以多选择视频QA格式确定任务,以全面评价这三类空间构象的存在:地标(识别和定位显著物体的能力)、路线(连接两个地点的环绕表示)和调查知识(融合多个路线的万国中心地图)[51];见图1(距离)。

blocks.en:
KilometerVision contains 1000 5-way video QAs, defined over 235 YouTube videos. For each question, the model receives a (segment of a) walking tour video together with a question about the video and 5 possible options, out of which only one is correct. The questions are carefully formulated to probe VLMs’ visual spatial capabilities rather than their semantic knowledge about various places.
We evaluate five state-of-the-art VLMs: Gemini 2.5 Flash [ 50 ] , PLM-8B [ 9 ] , Qwen2.5-VL-72B [ 4 ] , Claude Opus [ 3 ] , GPT-5 [ 36 ] . While our experimental results show a large performance variation across model families and model sizes, a consistent limitation emerges across all models: rather than utilising true path integration or building geometric mental maps, current VLMs predominantly bypass complex spatial reasoning by relying on 2D visual recognition and semantic text-matching.
blocks.zh:
公里数 视觉包含1000个5条路视频QA,定义超过235个YouTube视频. 对于每个问题,模型都会收到一个(包含a的)步行巡回录影带,同时收到一个有关视频和5个可能选项的问题,其中只有一个是正确的. 这些问题的精心设计是为了探究VLMs的视觉空间能力,而不是他们对各个地方的语义知识.
我们评价五种最先进的VLM:双子座2.5闪光[50],PLM-8B[9],Qun2.5-VL-72B [4],克劳德·奥普斯 [3],GPT-5 [36]. 虽然我们的实验结果显示,模型家族和模型大小之间的性能差异很大,但在所有模型中都出现了一致的局限性:不是利用真正的路径集成或构建几何智能地图,目前的VLM主要通过依赖2D视觉识别和语义文本匹配来绕过复杂的空间推理.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Large multimodal models and evaluation: Recent advances in large multimodal models (VLMs) [ 27 , 67 , 30 , 29 , 8 , 50 ] are often achieved by integrating high-dimensional, continuous sensory signals ( e.g . , visual and audio) into compact representations as inputs to large language models. In order to capture visual information, some approaches [ 67 , 8 , 27 , 62 , 29 ] employ pre-trained image encoders [ 66 , 37 ] to extract representations from individual frames, whereas other approaches [ 57 , 32 ] utilize video encoders to extract (short-term) spatiotemporal representations. Beyond distributed representations, it has been demonstrated [ 30 , 55 , 58 ] that interpretable video representations, such as dense captions, often capture sufficient information for many existing video question answering benchmarks, such as NextQA [ 60 ] and EgoSchema [ 33 ] .
blocks.zh: 大型多式联运模式和评价: 大型多式联运模型(VLM)[27,67,30,29,8,50]的近期进步往往是通过将高维,连续的感官信号(如视觉和音频)整合到紧凑的表示中,作为对大型语言模型的投入来实现的. 为了捕捉视觉信息,有些方法[67、8、27、62、29]使用经过事先训练的图像编码器[66、37]从单个帧中提取表示,而其他方法[57、32]则使用视频编码器提取(短期)瞬间表示。 除了分布式表述外,还证明[30,55,58]可解释的视频表述,如密集字幕,往往能为许多现有的视频问题回答基准,如NextQA[60]和EgoSchema[33],获取足够的信息.

blocks.en: The success of VLMs has inspired researchers to introduce more challenging benchmarks beyond action classification [ 6 ] and localization [ 5 , 21 ] . One such attempt aims to evaluate multimodal concept abstraction and spatiotemporal reasoning, in either synthetic [ 18 , 65 ] , egocentric [ 12 , 20 ] , or carefully curated real-world scenarios [ 40 ] . Another attempt focuses on long-form video understanding, where the videos are usually sourced from movies [ 49 , 42 ] , or procedural demonstrations [ 68 , 33 , 20 ] and vlogs [ 14 ] . Finally, a trend in recent benchmarks aims at offering a comprehensive evaluation on various aspects of multimodal perception and reasoning from diverse domains, such as VideoMME [ 15 ] and LVBench [ 56 ] .
blocks.zh: VLMs的成功激励了研究人员在行动分类[6]和本地化[5,21]之外引入更具挑战性的基准. 其中一种尝试旨在评价多式联运概念的抽象化和瞬间推理,无论是在合成[18、65]、自我中心[12、20],还是仔细分析的现实世界情景[40]中。 另一个尝试侧重于长式视频理解,视频通常来自电影[49,42],或程序演示[68,33,20]和vlogs [14]. 最后,最近基准的趋势是,从不同领域,如VideoMME[15]和LV Bench[56],对多式联运概念和推理的各个方面进行全面评估。

blocks.en: Benchmarking spatial intelligence: Traditionally, spatial understanding was evaluated through low-level tasks like depth estimation [ 17 , 34 ] , pose estimation [ 23 ] , or 3D reconstruction [ 22 , 13 , 28 ] , tackled by specialised methods (SFM [ 38 ] , SLAM [ 22 , 13 ] ). Given VLMs’ potential to become general perception models, more and more efforts are focusing on evaluating their spatial capabilities using a language interface, often taking inspiration from the cognitive literature to design challenging tasks [ 40 , 64 , 31 , 41 ] . The main question that these works try to answer is if the current internet-scale training datasets and strategies can allow spatial intelligence to emerge [ 52 , 41 , 64 , 47 , 31 , 53 ] , can VLMs learn a valid world model of physical environments by learning from passively observed data.
blocks.zh: 空间情报基准: 传统上,空间理解是通过深度估计[17、34]、提出估计[23]或以专门方法处理的三维重建[22、13、28]等低层次任务加以评估的(可持续森林管理[38]、SLAM[22、13])。 鉴于VLMs成为一般感知模型的潜力,越来越多的工作集中在利用语言界面评估其空间能力,经常从认知文献中汲取灵感来设计具有挑战性的任务[40、64、31、41]。 这些作品试图回答的主要问题是,目前的互联网规模培训数据集和战略能否允许空间智能出现[52,41,64,47,31,53],VLMs能否通过学习被动观测的数据来学习一个有效的物理环境世界模型.

blocks.en: Large-scale geographic capabilities: Several works have tried to push the envelope of spatial understanding to geographic scale, due to the unique challenges that such settings expose in terms of memory and long-context understanding. The authors of [ 52 ] study the world model learnt by an LLM from a large-scale text taxi rides dataset. Still using only text modality, the authors of [ 43 , 63 ] design tasks probing geographic knowledge in LLMs. In [ 44 ] images are provided as inputs as well. Other works are attempting to place VLM agents in interactive environments to probe their planning and navigation capabilities [ 7 , 25 , 61 ] . Our proposed benchmark is novel and complements these existing benchmarks, being the first to use real-world videos of walking tours [ 54 ] to comprehensively probe VLMs’ capabilities to recognise landmarks, routes, and build mental maps of cities from videos alone.
blocks.zh: 大规模地理能力: 若干作品试图将空间理解的包袱推向地理范围,因为这些环境在记忆和长文理解方面面临独特的挑战。 [52] 的作者研究了一个LLM从一个大型文本出租车中吸取的世界模型,搭乘数据集. 仍然只使用文本模式,[43,63]设计任务的作者在LLMs中探究地理知识. 在[44]项中,图像也作为投入提供。 其他作品试图将VLM代理置于互动环境中,以探究其规划和导航能力[7,25,61]. 我们提出的基准是新颖的,并补充了这些现有的基准,是第一个使用真实世界的步行游览视频[54]来全面探索VLMs识别地标、路线的能力,并从视频中绘制城市的精神地图。

blocks.en: 3 Video dataset
blocks.zh: 3个视频数据集

blocks.en: 3.1 Video source
blocks.zh: 3.1 视频来源

blocks.en: We rely on high-resolution real-world hour-long YouTube Walking Tour videos filmed in various cities around the world. In these videos, the camera wearer walks around the city, visiting landmarks, sometimes returning to places already visited ( i.e . loop closures). We start from the nine city-life videos in the Walking Tours dataset [ 54 ] , and select 226 extra YouTube videos with similar characteristics (high-resolution, hour-long), prioritising diverse coverage of cities in different countries, for a total of 235 videos with about 288 hours of video data.
blocks.zh: 我们依赖全球各城市拍摄的高分辨率真实世界小时YouTube漫步巡回赛视频。 在这些视频中,摄像头穿戴者走在城市周围,访问地标,有时会返回已经访问过的地方(即环路关闭). 我们从"步行之旅"数据集中的9个城市生活视频[54]开始,再选择226个具有类似特征(高分辨率,小时)的YouTube视频,优先对不同国家的城市进行多样的覆盖,共计235个视频,视频数据约288小时.

blocks.en: 3.2 Grounding videos on the map
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 在地图上放置视频

blocks.en: To facilitate extracting annotations for our tasks, we first design an efficient pipeline to ground the videos on the map, i.e . extract the ( latitude , longitude ) coordinates and camera pose of each frame in the video at a given frame rate, e.g . 1 FPS. This produces detailed accurate route traces on the map (see Fig. 1 , centre), which instantly reveal important aspects that would otherwise require watching a long video, possibly multiple times, to discover, e.g . loop closures when walking around in a neighbourhood and returning to the same place on a different path. Given such map traces, we can then use simple heuristics and minimal human annotations to extract at scale ground-truth annotations for various spatial tasks.
blocks.zh: 为了便于为我们的任务提取说明,我们首先设计一个高效的管道,在地图上对视频进行地面定位,即以给定的帧率提取视频中每个帧的(纬度,经度)坐标和相机姿势,例如1 FPS. 这在地图上产生了详细的准确的路线痕迹(见图1,中心),这些痕迹立即揭示了重要方面,否则需要观看一段长视频,可能要多次,才能发现,例如,在邻里行走和返回不同路径的同一地点时循环关闭. 鉴于这种地图痕迹,我们可以使用简单的休眠术和最低限度的人类说明,为各种空间任务大规模提取地面真实说明。

blocks.en: We leverage Google’s Visual Positioning System (VPS) [ 48 ] , a public API that relies on StreetView imagery to estimate the location and camera pose of any query image. Given a query image, VPS calculates its embedding using an image encoder, then retrieves the (lat, lon) coordinates and camera pose of the nearest neighbour image stored in Google StreetView embedding. For this operation to be efficient, an estimate of the location is also necessary ( e.g . within 100m of the true location). Given this constraint and to run efficiently on long videos, we rely on human raters to provide the (lat, lon) coordinates corresponding to the start and end of each walking tour video in our dataset. Then, we run the VPS API on consecutive video frames at 1FPS, updating the location estimate with the newly returned location as the video progresses.
blocks.zh: 我们利用Google的视觉定位系统[48], 鉴于一个查询图像,VPS使用图像编码器计算其嵌入,然后检索存储在Google StreetView嵌入的最近邻居图像的坐标和相机姿势(lat,lon). 为了使这一行动有效率,还需要对地点作出估计(例如,在实际地点100米以内)。 鉴于这一制约因素,为了高效运行长视频,我们依靠人类测评器提供(lat,lon)坐标,以对应我们数据集中每个行走旅游视频的始末. 然后,我们在1FPS的连续视频帧上运行VPS API,随着视频的进展,更新了新返回的位置估计.

blocks.en: In more detail, for each given frame, the VPS output is a tuple ( lat , lon , rot , trans , confidence ) (\text{lat},\allowbreak\text{lon},\allowbreak\text{rot},\allowbreak\text{trans},\allowbreak\text{confidence}) , where (latitude, longitude) are real scalar values, rot represents the camera rotation as a quaternion in the Earth-Centered, Earth-Fixed (ECEF) coordinate system rot ∈ ℝ 4 \text{rot}\in\mathbb{R}^{4} , trans is the camera translation as a matrix ℝ 1 × 3 \mathbb{R}^{1\times 3} , and the confidence score is between 0.0 and 1.0. If this confidence score is larger than a given threshold, we update the estimated location with the newly returned location, otherwise we keep the existing estimate when processing the next frame. To improve the quality of the VPS predictions, we repeat the operation but in reverse order using the last frame’s human-annotated position as initial estimate and making VPS calls consuming the video frames in reverse. The two passes are then merged by using a confidence-weighted average between the forward pass predictions and the reverse pass. Finally, a last VPS run is executed, using each frame’s weighted average as initial estimate for that frame. Note that, despite the repeated runs, this is a robust pipeline that can be run at scale on thousands of hour-long videos; for our 288 hours of videos, it takes about a day to do the full processing. To circumvent VPS errors in feature-poor areas [ 24 ] , we apply outlier removal as detailed in the appendix.
blocks.zh: 更详细地说,对于每个给定的框架,VPS输出是tuple(拉特,龙,腐烂,反转,信任) (\text{lat},\allowbreak\text{lon},\allowbreak\text{rot},\allowbreak\text{trans},\allowbreak\text{自信}),其中(纬度,经度)是真实的平面值,腐烂代表相机自转,作为地心,地心(ECEF)坐标系统 rotext 4\text{rotin\mathbb{R}^{4},转录为相机翻译为矩阵R1×3\mathbb{R}^{1\时3},信任分在0.0和1.0之间. 如果这个置信分数大于给定阈值,我们用新返回的位置更新估计位置,否则在处理下一个帧时保留现有的估计. 为了提高VPS预测的质量,我们重复了操作,但以反向顺序使用最后帧的人为附加说明的位置作为初步估计,并让VPS呼叫反向消耗视频帧. 然后通过使用前传预测和逆传的置信加权平均值将这两段通行证合并. 最后,用每个帧的加权平均数作为该帧的初步估计数,执行最后一次VPS运行。 请注意,尽管多次运行,这是一个强大的管道,可以在几千小时的视频上大规模运行;对于我们288小时的视频,大约需要一天的时间才能完成全部处理. 为避免在地物贫瘠地区出现VPS错误[24],我们采用附录中详述的排除值。

blocks.en:
To validate this approach of grounding videos on the map, we compared the obtained traces against traces collected by humans using Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) as a metric. To calibrate the DTW metric, i.e . get a sense of what is an acceptable error between human-collected ground truth and an automatically extracted VPS path, we collected 2 parallel human annotations for a set of 10 hour-long videos ( ∼ \sim 15 hours of video data) using Google Maps as annotation interface and asking human raters to draw on the map the path followed by the camera wearer. Twelve more videos ( ∼ \sim 14 hours of data) were used for validation. Overall, about 10% of the data has human annotations.
For each video, we calculated the DTW distance between the two human-provided paths, giving us a measure of acceptable variability between two paths representing the same walking tour. We then calculated DTW distances between VPS traces and human-provided traces, and discarded segments of the VPS trace where the DTW metric was above the threshold; more details are included in the appendix. It is worth noting that the cost reduction offered by our pipeline is massive. Human raters need only ∼ \sim 5 minutes per video to mark the location of the start and end of the video, then the video is grounded automatically. Without our pipeline, drawing manually the full path on the map took ∼ \sim 6 hours per 1h-long video and it only provides position information, not pose.
blocks.zh:
为了验证这种将视频放置在地图上的方法,我们用动态时间摇摆(DTW)作为衡量标准,比较了人类收集的痕迹。 为了校准DTW的度量标准,即了解人类收集的地面真相与自动提取的VPS路径之间的可接受错误,我们用Google Maps作为注释界面,用摄像头穿戴者所遵循的路径,收集了两条平行的人类注释. 另有12个视频(\\sim 14小时数据)用于验证. 总体而言,大约10%的数据有人类说明。
对每段视频,我们计算了两条人行道之间的DTW距离,使我们可以衡量代表同一行走路线的两条道路之间的可接受差异。 然后,我们计算了VPS痕迹与人提供的痕迹之间的DTW距离,并计算了DTW度量高于阈值的VPS痕量中被丢弃的部分;更多细节载于附录中. 值得指出的是,我们的输油管能够大量减少费用。 人类评分员每段视频只需 \\ sim 5分钟即可标注视频始末的位置,然后视频自动被禁播. 没有我们的管道,人工绘制地图上的全部路径每1h长的视频需要\\sim6小时,它只提供位置信息,而不是姿势.

blocks.en: In a recent parallel work [ 28 ] , the authors relied on ARIA glasses to similarly ground walking tour videos on the map and design a city-scale benchmark for SLAM systems. Compared to this work, which requires a person to wear the ARIA glasses and walk around to collect the videos, our system allows us to ground at scale any already-filmed video, with any camera, anywhere in the world.
blocks.zh: 在最近的一篇平行作品[28]中,提交人依靠ARIA眼镜在地图上拍摄类似的地面步行旅游录像,并为SLAM系统设计了一个城市尺度基准。 与这部作品相比,这部作品要求一个人戴着ARIA眼镜,到处走来走去收集视频,而我们的系统允许我们用任何摄像头在世界上任何地方大规模地播放任何已经拍摄过的视频。

blocks.en: 4 Benchmark tasks
blocks.zh: 4 基准任务

blocks.en:
As evidenced in the cognitive literature, continued exposure to a new environment leads to three stages of spatial awareness in humans: landmark-route-map [ 10 ] . At the landmark stage, we observe salient objects ( e.g . a clock tower or a statue) that we can easily recognise and allow us to anchor ourselves in space. At the route stage, we infer sequences of turns that allow us to move from one landmark to another. Finally, the mental map stage corresponds to an overall layout of the environment that allows us to derive knowledge not readily observed while interacting with the environment, e.g . shortcuts.
We define evaluation tasks at these three levels of representation to probe if VLMs develop similar constructs. We rely on multiple-choice video QA format because modern VLMs process and generate text natively, providing a standardised and accessible interface for evaluation. Importantly, this format grants us access to the models’ intermediate “thinking traces”, allowing us to qualitatively investigate the actual strategies they use to solve spatial problems. In contrast, attempting to explicitly extract continuous 3D spatial representations like metric depth maps, 3D point clouds, or dense topological graphs, directly from the latent spaces of general-purpose VLMs, would be highly non-trivial and model specific.
blocks.zh:
如认知文献所示,持续接触新环境导致人类的空间意识分三个阶段:标志性-路由-地图[10]. 在标志性阶段,我们观测到一些突出的物体(例如钟楼或雕像),我们可以轻易地识别这些物体,并允许我们在太空中站稳脚跟。 在路由阶段,我们推断出转弯顺序,使我们能够从一个地标转向另一个地标。 最后,精神映射阶段对应环境的整体布局,使我们能够在与环境互动时获得不易观察到的知识,例如快捷键.
我们确定这三级代表性的评价任务,以在甚高频开发类似构象时进行探测。 我们依赖多选择视频QA格式,因为现代的VLM处理和本土生成文本,为评价提供了一个标准化和可访问的界面. 重要的是,这种形式使我们能够查阅模型的中间 " 思维痕迹 " ,使我们能够从质量上调查它们用来解决空间问题的实际战略。 与此相反,试图直接从通用VLM的潜在空间中明确提取连续的3D空间表示,如测量深度图、3D点云或密集的地形图,将是高度非三角性和模式性的。

To keep the evaluation efficient, we define the tasks on video segments of up to 10 minutes long. At average walking speed, a 10-minute segment corresponds to about 1km distance traversed; see examples of corresponding map traces in Fig. 5 .
We include up to 150 QAs for each type of task, again for efficiency reasons. But note that given our pipeline to ground videos on the map, we can efficiently generate a larger number of questions for each task (with the exception of loop closure, as loops occur less frequently in walking tours). Fig. 2 shows the distribution of tasks and video lengths in the benchmark. When compared to prior work, e.g . VSI-Bench, our videos are 3-6 × \times longer, covering much larger spatial areas (factory vs . neighbourhood).

blocks.en: 4.1 Landmarks
blocks.zh: 4.1 地标

blocks.en: Landmark recognition: We define landmark recognition tasks by using a non-standard multiple-choice video QA format. The model is presented with a text question, a video clip, and a picture of a landmark that may or may not have appeared on the path shown in the clip. The questions are of the form:
blocks.zh: 地标识别: 我们通过使用非标准的多选择视频QA格式来定义标志性识别任务. 该模型呈现的是文本问题,视频剪辑,以及可能出现在剪辑中显示的路径上也可能没有出现的地标图片. 问题的形式是:

blocks.en: Does the image show a location in the video, and if so, what is the straight-line distance between the camera location of the image and the camera location of the final video frame?
blocks.zh: 图像是否显示视频中的位置,如果是,图像的相机位置与最终视频帧的相机位置之间的直线距离是多少?

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Examples of landmark frames (Left: Amsterdam, right: Venice).
blocks.zh: 图3:标志性框架的例子(左:阿姆斯特丹,右:威尼斯).

blocks.en: This is followed by four possible distances in meters (one being the correct one if the landmark is in the given video), plus a fifth negative option: That place was not seen in the video . For simplicity, we select landmark images from the video frames themselves, by filtering for video frames that have very high VPS confidence scores ( > .98 >.98 ), under the intuition that these are the most distinctive; we also apply non-maximal suppression to keep only the peaks and remove duplicates. Examples of landmark pictures obtained after this filtering are included in Fig. 3 , for Walking Tour videos filmed in Amsterdam and Venice, respectively. Fig. 4 shows the distribution of correct answers for landmark distances. We also include questions for which the negative answer is the correct one. In these cases, we extract landmarks from parts of the video that do not overlap with the current segment. Note that this landmark recognition task is an example of needle-in-haystack problem, at which Transformer-like architectures are known to excel [ 50 ] , and our results confirm this (see Sec. 5.3 and analysis in Fig. 9 , right).
blocks.zh: 接下来是4米可能的距离(如果地标位于给定视频中,则1米为正确距离),再加上第五个负选项: 那个地方没有在视频中看到。 为了简单起见,我们通过过滤VPS置信分数非常高的视频帧( >.98 >.98),从视频帧本身中选择标志性图像,直觉上认为这些图像最有特色;我们还应用非哺乳动物压制,只保留峰值,去除重复. 过滤后获得的标志性图片的例子载于图3,用于阿姆斯特丹和威尼斯分别拍摄的步行旅游视频. 费格。 4,显示地标距离正确答案的分布. 我们还包括否定答案正确的问题。 在这些情况下,我们从部分视频中提取出与当前部分没有重叠的地标. 请注意,这一里程碑式的识别任务是一个针入海斯塔克问题的例子,在这个例子中,类似变形器的建筑已知是优异的[50],我们的结果证实了这一点(见Sec. 5.3和图9的分析,右方)。

blocks.en: Distance to landmark: Note that the second part of the question above related to distance estimation requires map-level knowledge. We use this composite form for efficiency reasons, to run a single model query. In the analysis of the results, we break down the performance into landmark recognition and distance estimation, see Fig. 9 , right.
blocks.zh: 距离地标 : 注意上述问题第二部分与距离估计有关,需要地图层面的知识. 出于效率的原因,我们使用这个复合形式,运行一个单一的模型查询. 在对结果的分析中,我们把性能细分为具有里程碑意义的识别和距离估计,参见图9,右.

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Left: Distribution of line-of-sight distances (in metres) to landmarks used in our dataset. We also include questions with landmarks that haven’t been visited on the tour, for which the correct answer is ‘not seen’. Centre-left: Distribution of orientations at the end of the walking tour for the compass task. Centre-right: Distribution of Euclidean distances between the start and the end of each tour. Right: Distribution of loop lengths in seconds; maximum video length is 600 seconds (10 minutes). We also include 11 question-answer pairs where there is no loop.
blocks.zh: 图4:左边:将视线距离(米)分布到我们数据集使用的地标。 我们还包括一些具有里程碑意义的问题, 中左:为罗盘任务在行走之旅结束后分发方向. 中-右:在每次巡演的开始和结束之间分配欧几利得距离. 对: 循环长度以秒计的分配;最大视频长度为600秒(10分钟). 我们还包括11个没有循环的回答对。

blocks.en: 4.2 Routes
blocks.zh: 4.2 路线

blocks.en:
Compass: We formulate compass questions related to global camera orientation by giving the orientation of the camera at the beginning of the clip and asking the model to output the orientation at the end of the clip. These allow us to probe the model’s ability to perform simplified path integration, necessary for understanding routes and building mental maps of large-scale environments [ 39 ] . To correctly answer this question, the model could keep track of point correspondences across frames and estimate the camera motion. Alternatively, the model could infer the cardinal orientation using visual cues, e.g . the sun position.
However, such cues are often not available ( e.g . if the person walks on a narrow street and the sun position cannot be inferred), so the camera motion estimation is a more reliable strategy. We use the following question prompt: For this question, you need to keep track of the direction that the camera is facing throughout the given walking tour video. Given that the camera is pointing towards the <orientation_start> at the start, where is the camera pointing at the very end?
blocks.zh:
Compass:我们通过在剪辑开头给出镜头的取向,请模型在剪辑结尾输出取向,来制定与全球镜头定向有关的指南针问题. 这些可以让我们探究模型实现简化路径集成的能力,这是理解路径和绘制大规模环境的心理图所必需的[39]. 为了正确回答这个问题,模型可以跟踪跨帧的点对应,并估计相机运动. 或者,模型可以使用视觉提示(例如太阳位置)推断主要方向。
然而,这种提示往往不可用(例如,如果人行走在狭窄的街道上,阳光位置无法推断),所以相机运动估计是一种更可靠的策略. 我们使用下面的问题提示: 对于这个问题,你需要跟踪摄影机在整个给定的步行巡回录影带中面对的方向. 鉴于相机在起始时指向"定向_启动",相机指向甚么端?

blocks.en: The orientation is binned into one of eight possibilities: North, Northeast, East, Southeast, South, Southwest, West, Northwest . The ground-truth end orientation and the start orientation are extracted automatically from the VPS predictions after outlier removal. Rotation quaternions in the ECEF reference frame are mapped to the local tangent plane to calculate the yaw with respect to the direction pointing towards north at that location. The 4 incorrect options in the multiple-choice task are sampled at random. Clips of up to 10-minutes duration are sampled at random such that the start and end frames have high-confidence VPS predictions. We start by extracting a large number of possible questions, and we filter down to keep a subset of 150 QAs by sampling at random questions with distinct start and end orientations; see the distribution of orientations in Fig. 4 , centre-left.
blocks.zh: 取向分为八种可能性之一:北,东北,东,东南,南,西南,西,西北. 地面真实的终点方向和起始方向在清除出局后从VPS预测中自动提取. ECEF参考框架的轮廓四角线被绘制到当地正切平面上,以计算该位置向北方向的黄道。 多选择任务中的4个不正确的选项是随机抽样的. 长达10分钟的剪贴板随机取样,使起始和结束帧具有高度自信的VPS预测. 我们首先抽取大量可能的问题,我们通过随机抽查问题来过滤来保持150个QA的子集,并有不同的起始和结尾方向;参见图4,中左方向的分布.

blocks.en: Loop closure detection: This is a critical task in large-scale spatial understanding, commonly used by simultaneous localisation and mapping systems (SLAM) [ 11 , 35 ] to correct navigation drift. SLAM solutions rely on a combination of visual recognition and geometric path integration strategies. We formulate loop closure detection questions in multiple-choice format, bridging in this way the gap between the VLM and SLAM communities.
blocks.zh: 循环关闭检测 : 这是大规模空间理解中的一项关键任务,通常用于同时定位和绘图系统(SLAM)[11,35]纠正导航漂移. SLAM解决方案依赖于视觉识别和几何路径融合策略的结合. 我们以多种选择的形式提出环闭检测问题,从而弥合VLM和SLAM社区之间的差距。

blocks.en: Given our videos grounded on the map, we extract candidate loops by running a simple heuristic over the VPS predictions, checking if the current VPS point has been visited previously within a 4m radius. Then, we conduct manual inspection of the candidate loops with human raters to remove false positives caused by possible VPS outliers. We use the following question prompt in our benchmark:
blocks.zh: 基于地图的视频,我们通过在VPS预测上运行一个简单的heuristic来提取候选环路,检查当前VPS点是否之前在4m半径范围内访问过. 然后,我们用人工检查 候选循环与人评分 清除假阳性 由可能的 VPS 外置。 我们使用我们基准中的下列问题:

blocks.en: Has the location at the end of the video been visited at an earlier point in the video? If so, when?
blocks.zh: 视频结尾的位置是否在视频较早的地方被访问过?. 如果是,何时?

blocks.en: The negative options are sampled at random making sure that they are at least 1 minute apart from the correct option. Note that we also sample negative questions, i.e . questions for which the correct answer is The location has not been visited before in this video. Figure 5 shows trace examples of positive and negative scenarios and Fig. 4 shows the distribution of loop lengths in our dataset. We opted to use this composite formulation that includes the time recall to be able to generate five meaningful answer options instead of the binary Yes / No. We break down the performance into loop closure detection and time recall in Fig. 9 , right, for analysis purposes.
blocks.zh: 负选项随机抽样,以确保它们与正确的选项相距至少1分钟. 请注意,我们也抽样了负面问题,即正确答案是"地点"的问题,本视频之前没有访问过. 图5显示正负情景的微量实例,图4显示我们数据集循环长度的分布. 我们选择采用这种综合提法,其中包括时间回顾,以便能够产生五个有意义的答案选项,而不是二进制是/否。 我们在图9中将性能分解为循环关闭检测和时间召回,用于分析目的.
(b) 国家

blocks.en: Figure 5 : (a) Example of a VPS trace with a loop. (b) Example of a VPS trace without a loop. (c) Given the VPS coordinates for a video segment (shown in red), we select high-confidence intermediate VPS points to query the Google Maps Compute Routes API and get a closely-matching trace (shown in blue). Black segments indicate the optimal pairings found by DTW (Dynamic Time Warping) metric. In green, we show the maximum distance (error).
blocks.zh: 图5 : (a)带有环的VPS追踪示例. (b) 无循环的VPS追踪实例。 (c) 鉴于视频段的VPS坐标(以红色显示),我们选择了高自信中间VPS点来查询Google地图计算路由API,并获得一个紧密匹配的痕迹(以蓝色显示)。 黑色片段表示DTW(Dynamic Time Warping)度量衡发现的最佳配对. 在绿色中,我们显示最大距离(error).

blocks.en: Route summary: We define route summary tasks to probe if the model can identify a summary of the path shown in the video in terms of navigation actions (turn left, turn right, go straight). The question prompt is: Which of these sets of directions correctly represent the path of the person in this video?
blocks.zh: 路线摘要 : 我们定义路线摘要任务,如果模型能够从导航动作(左转,右转,直走)的角度识别视频中显示的路径摘要的话,就进行探测. 问题提示是:这些方向中哪一组正确代表了这段视频中人物的路径?

blocks.en: To generate the ground truth answers, we rely on Google Maps Routes API that we query using VPS coordinates for start, end, and intermediate points. To ensure that the generated route closely matches the actual path followed in the video (and indicated by VPS), we sample multiple routes using Routes API using different intermediate points and then we use again DTW distance (mentioned in sec 3.2 ) to select the best match with the VPS trace; see Fig. 5 (c). If the maximum error between optimal pairs found by DTW is not below a given threshold, we discard the question. The pipeline allows us to generate and check a large number of questions very efficiently, so we can afford to select only the questions that satisfy our error constraints. Finally, we keep as correct answer the text description returned by the Routes API for this best match 1 1 1 We also experimented with fitting a polyline to the VPS predicted locations and deriving the sequence of turns from it, but this led to noisier redundant navigation instructions. .
blocks.zh: 为了生成地面真相答案,我们依靠Google Maps Routes API,我们使用VPS坐标来查询起始,结束和中间点. 为确保生成的路由与视频所遵循的实际路由(由VPS表示)紧密匹配,我们使用Routes API使用不同的中间点对多个路由进行取样,然后再次使用DTW距离(在第3.2节中提及)来选择与VPS跟踪的最佳匹配;参见图5(c). 如果DTW发现的最佳配对之间的最大误差不低于给定的阈值,我们就放弃这个问题. 管道使我们能够非常有效地产生和检查大量的问题,因此我们只能选择满足我们错误限制的问题。 最后,我们把路由API返回的文本描述作为正确答案,用于这一最佳匹配的11.1,我们还试验了在VPS预测的地点安装多线,并从中得出转弯的顺序,但这导致了鼻音冗余的导航指令. 。 。 。

blocks.en: To generate the negative options, we consider partially-overlapping segments, forcing the model to correctly identify the start and end point of the tour to discard these. Another negative option that we use is the reversed version of the ground truth path. Fig. 6 (top) shows some possible options, which are also used for the map trace task explained below.
blocks.zh: 为了生成负面选项,我们考虑部分重叠的片段,迫使模型正确识别巡演的起点和终点以丢弃这些. 我们使用的另一个负面选项是倒转版的地面真理路径. 图6(顶部)显示了一些可能的选项,这些选项也用于下文所解释的地图跟踪任务.

blocks.en: As an ablation, we also experimented with an easier version of the task, where we sample negative options from video segments that do not overlap with the ground truth segment at all; see appendix for more details.
blocks.zh: 作为一种淡化,我们还试验了比较容易的版本的任务,从视频段抽取完全不与地面真相段重叠的负面选项;详见附录.

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Top : Map trace images used as options for the Map trace task. Bottom : A more challenging map trace task variation where the route traces are in-painted over maps without text labels or landmark icons.
blocks.zh: 图6:顶级: 地图追踪图像作为地图追踪任务的选项. 底部 : 一个更具挑战性的地图微量任务变异,即路由痕迹在地图上涂上,没有文字标签或标志性图标.

blocks.en: 4.3 Survey Knowledge (Maps)
blocks.zh: 4.3 调查知识(地图)

blocks.en: Map trace (with text): At the ultimate map representation level, we aim to probe if the mental map inferred by the model for the given walking tour is valid. To this end, we formulate a first task that requires the model to identify the correct map trace of the tour from a set of five possible map traces, see Fig. 6 top. For this setting, we rely on a non-standard video QA configuration, where the question is given as text, and the options are provided as map images (with text labels and landmark icons overlaid on the map) alongside the input video. The question is of the form: Which of these maps correctly represent the path of the person in this video?
blocks.zh: 地图追踪( 有文本) : 在最终的地图代表级别上,我们的目标是探究模型为给定的步行旅行推断出的心理地图是否有效. 为此,我们制定了第一项任务,要求模型从一组五种可能的地图痕迹中识别出旅行的正确地图痕迹,参见图6上方. 对于此设置,我们依赖非标准视频QA配置,其中问题作为文本给出,选项作为地图图像(在地图上贴有文本标签和标志图标)与输入视频一起提供. 问题在于形式: 这些地图中哪一张正确代表了这段视频中人物的路径?

blocks.en: To generate the correct and the negative options for this task, we use the same pipeline as for the route summary task, but we plot visually on the map the answers from the Google Maps Routes API. Similarly to the route summary task, we set up the same ablation with the easier version of negatives; see appendix.
blocks.zh: 为了为这项任务生成正确和负面的选项,我们使用与路由汇总任务相同的管道,但我们在地图上以视觉方式绘制来自Google Maps Routes API的答案. 与路由汇总任务类似,我们用更简单的底片版本设置了同样的减速器;见附录.

blocks.en: Map trace (w/o text): To further challenge the video understanding capabilities of the evaluated VLMs, we add a version of the task where the map trace is overlaid on a bare map, without text labels or landmark icons; see Fig. 6 bottom.
blocks.zh: 地图追踪(w/o文本): 为了进一步挑战被评价的VLM的视频理解能力,我们增加了一个任务版本,即地图微量覆盖在赤裸的地图上,没有文字标签或标志图标;参见图6下方.

blocks.en:
Euclidean distance: The cognitive literature defines as the ultimate test for probing the validity of the mental map in large-scale environments the capability of estimating the Euclidean distance between two locations after exploring only non-Euclidean (longer) paths between those locations. In setups that allow interaction, the task is set up as finding a shortcut between two locations after exploring different connecting paths [ 10 ] .
In our setup, we define the task as estimating the Euclidean distance between the start and the end of a given walking tour, using the following prompt: For this question, you need to keep track of where the user is in the real world throughout the walking tour video. Based on that, what is the line-of-sight distance between the start point and the end point of this tour?
blocks.zh:
欧几利得距离 : 认知文献将仅探索两个地点之间的非欧几利得(Longer)路径后估计两个地点之间的欧几利得距离的能力定义为在大规模环境中检验心理图有效性的最终测试. 在允许交互的设置中,任务被设定为在探索不同的连接路径[10]后寻找两个位置之间的快捷方式.
在我们的设定中,我们将任务定义为估计一个给定的步行巡演的开始和结束之间的欧几利得距离,使用以下的提示: 对于这个问题,你需要在整个步行巡回录影带中追踪用户在现实世界中的位置. 在此基础上,这次巡演的起点和终点之间的视线距离是多少?

blocks.en: We extract the ground truth start and end positions using the VPS predictions and calculate the L2 distance. The four incorrect options for each question are sampled at random, making sure that they are not within 100m of the ground-truth to avoid ambiguity. Fig. 4 , centre-right, shows the distribution of correct answers in the benchmark.
blocks.zh: 我们利用 VPS 的预测来提取地面的真相开始和结束位置,并计算L2距离. 每个问题的四个不正确的选项都是随机抽取的,确保它们不在地面真相100米以内,以避免含糊不清. 图4中右侧显示基准中正确答案的分布。

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate PLM-8B, Qwen2.5-VL-72B, the efficient Gemini model, 2.5 Flash, and the strongest models from the GPT and Claude families, GPT-5 and Claude Opus 2 2 2 We use the model with 64k thinking tokens. The model without thinking obtains slightly lower performance (35.1% vs 34.9%). respectively. We also collected a human baseline and we ran a blind Gemini baseline by feeding blank frames to Gemini 2.5 Flash instead of the RGB frames; see Fig. 7 . It is important to note that the blind baseline has results at chance-level, confirming that our tasks cannot be answered from text alone.

blocks.en: 5.1 Human Baseline
blocks.zh: 5.1 人类基线

blocks.en:
We collected a small human baseline on a subset of the video QAs.
We randomly sampled 47-49 questions from each category, for a total of 337 QAs.
We recruited 18 crowd-sourced participants (male and female, with advanced English skills) and we collected 10 answers per question, from 10 different participants.
Each participant answered questions from between 3 and 7 categories.
The overall score for this baseline was 71.3%; see Fig. 7 for accuracy across tasks, with an inter-rater agreement of 0.76 across the dataset.
Most of the errors were encountered in the loop closure task, where the participants often mistakenly answered that there was no loop in the video.
This is the only task where the human baseline was outperformed by two of the evaluated VLMs.
Humans watched the videos at 30 FPS.
blocks.zh:
我们收集了一个小的人类基线 在视频QAs的子集。
我们从每个类别随机抽取了47-49个问题,共计337个质量保证。
我们招募了18名来自人群的参与者(男性和女性,具有先进的英语技能),我们从10名不同的参与者收集了10个问题的答复。
每位与会者回答3至7类的问题。
这一基线的总得分是71.3%,关于各项任务的准确性,见图7,整个数据集的评分协议为0.76。
大部分错误是在循环关闭任务中遇到的,参与者经常错误地回答视频中没有循环.
这是人类基线表现超过两个经评估的甚高频的唯一任务。
人类在30 FPS观看了视频.

blocks.en: 5.2 Results and Ablations
blocks.zh: 5.2 结果和缺陷

blocks.en: In our experiments, we found that PLM-8B and Qwen2.5-VL-72B can only process up to 32 frames, and Claude Opus API failed repeatedly on more than 32 frames. For fair comparison, we ran all models by uniformly sampling 32 frames for each question. Fig. 7 summarises the results. Overall, GPT-5 obtains the strongest performance, excelling at loop closure and route summary, but being significantly below human performance at all other tasks, especially tasks involving maps. PLM-8B and Qwen2.5-VL-72B show limited understanding capabilities, being on par with the blind baseline.
blocks.zh: 在我们的实验中,我们发现PLM-8B和Quen2.5-VL-72B只能处理到32帧,克劳德·奥普斯API在超过32帧上多次失败. 为了进行公平比较,我们通过对每个问题统一取样32帧来运行所有模型。 图7总结了结果。 总体而言,GPT-5获得了最强的性能,在环路关闭和路由汇总方面表现优异,但在所有其他任务,尤其是涉及地图的任务上却大大低于人类的性能. PLM-8B和Qun2.5-VL-72B显示理解能力有限,与盲基线相当。

blocks.en: Impact of frame rate and spatial resolution: To decouple intrinsic spatial capabilities from the memory limitations of each model, we also evaluated Gemini 2.5 Flash and GPT-5 (the only models that can run reliably with more than 32 frames per video) at their maximum temporal capacity to reflect the current SOTA upper bound and have a fairer comparison with the human baseline. We include results in Fig. 8 , left. Gemini 2.5 Flash shows almost no improvement when increasing the number of frames (32 → \rightarrow 600; ∼ \sim 38% accuracy), while GPT-5 improves significantly from 45% to 57%. This suggests that only larger-scale models are capable of exploiting additional frames due to higher-level video understanding capabilities. To understand how spatial resolution impacts performance, we ran an ablation with Claude Opus downsampling the frames to 200 pixels on the smaller side (from 400 pixels used in the main experiment). The performance mainly degrades across tasks, with the exception of map related tasks, where the accuracy stays at chance-level irrespective of the spatial resolution.
blocks.zh: 帧率和空间分辨率的影响: 为了将内在空间能力与每个模型的内存限制脱钩,我们还评价了双子座2.5 Flash和GPT-5(唯一能够可靠运行的模型,每段视频超过32帧),以最大的时间能力来反映当前SOTA的上限,并与人类基线进行更公平的比较. 我们在图8中列出结果,左。 双子座 2.5 Flash在增加帧数(32 ~\正弦 600;\sim 38%精度)时显示几乎没有任何改善,而GPT-5则从45%大幅提升到57%. 这表明,由于视频理解能力更高,只有更大的模型才能利用更多的帧. 为了了解空间分辨率如何影响性能,我们与克劳德·奥普斯(英语:Claude Opus)一起对帧进行下取样,到较小的侧面的200像素(从主实验中使用的400像素). 性能主要在跨任务之间退化,但与地图有关的任务除外,因为无论空间分辨率如何,精确度都保持在偶然的水平.

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Impact of frame rate (left) and of spatial resolution (right) on performance for different models.
blocks.zh: 图8:帧率(左)和空间分辨率(右)对不同模型性能的影响。

blocks.en: Passive visual observations vs . embodied perception: The cognitive literature outlines that humans have difficulties performing large-scale spatial tasks in passive setups without access to proprioception [ 10 ] . In an attempt to mimic additional modalities ( e.g . the vestibular signal), we run ablations with Gemini 2.5 Flash with additional privileged information to see if it can leverage them in a zero-shot regime. First, we investigate if providing camera pose and absolute VPS coordinates help with map trace recognition tasks (Fig 9 , left). Then, we investigate if providing maps helps with the Route summary task (Table 2 ). Finally, we check if providing the ground truth route summary helps with map trace recognition tasks, given that these models are experts at processing text information (Table 2 ). We can observe that providing camera pose or VPS traces does not help significantly, suggesting that fine-tuning might be needed for the model to learn to leverage them. Providing maps with text labels helps in summarising the routes, but maps without labels actually hurt performance. Similarly, providing the route text summary for map recognition tasks helps, but only when the maps have text labels overlaid. Interestingly, performance increases for these tasks when we remove the video completely and provide only the map with text labels or the text route summaries, suggesting that the model is able to read the map to some extent when it is allowed to allocate all its attention to it, instead of trying to correlate the map information with visual cues in the video.
blocks.zh: 被动视觉观察与.内含的感觉: 认知文献概述了人类在被动设置中难以完成大规模空间任务而无法获得自主性[10]. 为了模仿额外的模式(例如前导信号),我们用双子座2.5 Flash进行擦伤,并附加额外的特权信息,看看它是否能够在零镜头的制式中利用它们. 首先,我们调查是否提供相机姿势和绝对的VPS坐标帮助进行地图跟踪识别任务(图9,左). 然后,我们调查是否提供地图有助于完成路线摘要任务(表2)。 最后,我们检查是否提供地面真相路径摘要有助于地图跟踪识别任务,因为这些模型是处理文本信息的专家(表2)。 我们可以观察到,提供相机姿势或VPS痕迹没有多大帮助,这表明可能需要微调,使模型学会如何发挥杠杆作用. 提供带有文字标签的地图有助于概括路线,但没有标签的地图实际上会损害性能. 同样,为地图识别任务提供路由文本摘要也有帮助,但只有在地图有文字标签覆盖时才有用. 有趣的是,当我们完全删除视频时,这些任务的性能会提高,并且只向地图提供文本标签或文本路由摘要,这表明当允许将全部注意力都分配给地图时,模型能够在一定程度上阅读地图,而不是试图将地图信息与视频中的视觉提示联系起来.

blocks.en:
LLM Thinking ablation: We enable the thinking variant of models where possible, but in practice these
models think regardless. With thinking not enabled and the prompt strongly asking the model to answer with just the option number, both Claude Opus and Gemini Flash presented a detailed analysis of the question and options similar to those shown in Fig. 14-16 (Appendix).
Thus a strict ablation of this is currently challenging.
Nonetheless, we observe the following absolute accuracy changes when attempting to disable thinking in Gemini 2.5 Flash: Euclidean Distance (+15.5%), Loop closure (-3.6%), Route Summary (-4.8%), Compass (-10%). There is no clear trend as the model is often thinking regardless of not being prompted to do so.
blocks.zh:
LLM 语言 思惟灭欲: 我们尽可能使模型的思维变体成为可能,但实际上这些模型
模特儿想都别想 由于思绪未启用,且即时强烈要求模型仅用选项号来回答,克劳德·奥普斯和双子座闪电都详细分析了问题和与图14-16(附录)所示的选项相似的选项.
因此,目前对严格取消这种做法具有挑战性。
尽管如此,我们在双子座2.5闪电中试图禁用思维时观察到以下绝对准确性的变化:欧几利得距离(+15.5%)、环闭(-3.6%)、路由汇总(-4.8%)、康帕斯(-10%)。 目前没有明显的趋势,因为模型往往在思考,而不管是否被促使这样做。

blocks.en: 5.3 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5.3 讨论情况

blocks.en: In biological intelligence, spatial awareness develops hierarchically: anchoring via visual landmarks, connecting them via egocentric routes (path integration), and ultimately forming an allocentric, geometric map (survey knowledge). Our experiments reveal a fundamental divergence in how current AI models process spatial information.
blocks.zh: 在生物智能中,空间意识分级发展:通过视觉地标定位,通过自我中心路线(路径集成)连接它们,最终形成一个偏心,几何地图(调查知识). 我们的实验揭示了当前AI模型如何处理空间信息的根本分歧.

blocks.en:
a) The Landmark stage: visual recognition vs . spatial grounding. VLMs excel at visual recognition of landmarks in long videos, as can be observed in Fig. 9 right, where we separate performance for Landmark and Loop closure tasks into visual recognition ( i.e . determining the presence or absence of a landmark or loop) and selecting the correct distance/time option. However,
they acuity lack spatial grounding, given poor performance in estimating the Euclidean distance to the landmark or estimating when the loop started. Model traces (examples included in appendix) reveal an inability to infer 3D depth or scale from 2D pixels; they recognise what a landmark is, but not where it is relative to the observer.
blocks.zh:
(a) 国家 Landmark 舞台:视觉识别与空间定位. VLM在长视频中对地标的视觉识别方面表现优异,如图9右图所示,我们将Landmark和Loop关闭任务的性能分为视觉识别(即确定是否存在地标或环路),并选择正确的距离/时间选项. 不过
由于在估计欧几里得岛与地标的距离方面表现不佳,或者在环线开始时估计,它们缺乏空间定位。 模型痕迹(附录中包含的例子)显示无法从2D像素中推断3D深度或尺度;它们识别出什么是地标,而不是相对于观察者的位置.

blocks.en: Figure 9 : Left: Gemini 2.5 Flash performance on Map Trace questions with additional camera and/or VPS information. Right: Performance on Landmark and Loop Closure questions separated into Visual Recognition ( i.e . determining the presence or absence of a landmark or loop) and selecting the correct distance / time option, compared to overall (combined) performance.
blocks.zh: 图9:左:双子座2.5 在地图追踪问题上的闪光性能,加上额外的相机和/或VPS信息. 右侧:在Landmark和Loop闭合问题上的性能,分离成Visual Accident(即确定是否存在地标或环路),并选择正确的距离/时间选项,与整体(合并)性能相比.

blocks.en: b) The Route stage: semantic dependency over path integration. Biological route knowledge relies on path integration: the continuous tracking of movement and rotation. Our compass, loop closure, and route summary tasks demonstrate that VLMs fail at this physical tracking. When navigating cumulative angle changes, their geometric reasoning collapses. They attempt to recognise turn-left or turn-right actions ( e.g . for compass), but they fail most of the time at estimating the angles of rotations. This could also be due to the low frame rate that they can process. Instead, models rely almost exclusively on reading semantic cues ( e.g . street signs or text labels on the map, see ablations in Tables 2 and 2 ), effectively substituting reading comprehension for actual geometric path integration.
blocks.zh: (b) 财务 路由阶段:语义依赖于路径集成. 生物路线知识依赖于路径集成:对运动和旋转的持续跟踪. 我们的指南针、环路关闭和路由汇总任务表明,VLM在这种物理跟踪中失败。 当导航累积角度变化时,它们的几何推理会崩溃. 他们试图识别左转或右转动作(如罗盘),但在估计旋转角度时大部分时间都失败. 这也可能是因为他们可以处理的帧率低所致。 相反,模型几乎完全依赖阅读语义提示(例如. 地图上的街道标志或文本标签,参见表2和表2中的缩写,有效地取代了读取理解来进行实际几何路径集成.

blocks.en: c) The Map stage: illusion of survey knowledge. Mental maps allow humans to infer allocentric relationships, such as straight-line distances. Our Euclidean distance task and map trace recognition task reveal that VLMs possess only an illusion of this survey knowledge. The models default to text-matching street names (ablations in Tables 2 and 2 ), confirming that VLMs rely on OCR rather than matching geometric trajectories to map topology. It is worth noting that we tried to create similar visualisations of mental maps as in [ 64 ] , by defining a grid and asking the model to indicate the location of different landmarks, but preliminary results were not satisfactory.
blocks.zh: (c) 国家 地图阶段:勘测知识的幻觉. 精神图可以让人类推断出全心全意的关系,如直线距离. 我们的欧几利得距离任务和地图痕量识别任务显示,VLM只拥有这种调查知识的幻觉. 模型默认为文本匹配街道名称(缩写在表2和表2中),确认VLM依赖于OCR而不是匹配几何轨迹来映射地形. 值得注意的是,我们曾试图通过定义网格和要求模型指明不同地标的位置来创建类似于[64]中的精神地图的可视化,但初步结果并不令人满意.

blocks.en: Loop Closure: bypassing the mental map. Loop closure is the only task where two of the evaluated VLMs achieve super-human performance. However, model traces show that they bypass route or spatial map formation entirely, relying instead on exhaustive, brute-force visual frame matching. While effective, this approach is brittle. Latching onto misleading repeated visual cues can cause false positives ( e.g . the statue in Fig. 10 for Gemini 2.5 Flash), further highlighting the absence of underlying geometric awareness. More examples of thinking traces are included in the appendix.
blocks.zh: 循环关闭:绕过精神图. 循环关闭是两个被评价的VLM实现超人性能的唯一任务. 然而,模型痕迹表明它们完全绕过路线或空间地图形成,而是依赖于详尽无遗,野蛮的视觉框架匹配. 这种做法虽然有效,但并不明显。 锁定误导的重复视觉提示可造成假阳性(如图10中的雕像为双子座2.5 Flash),进一步凸显了缺乏基本的几何意识. 附录中增加了更多思考痕迹的例子。

Gemini correctly identifies the location at the end of the video 1 , and correctly eliminates another option 2 . The model incorrectly believes that a different statue that it can see in the distance is the same as the one it sees at the end of the video 3 . The model correctly determines that the camera is in the same location at time 9:17 but incorrectly decides that this was not visited earlier 4 . Claude Opus ’s reasoning is generally correct and it correctly identifies option ID 2 as the right answer.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduce KilometerVision , the first benchmark that comprehensively evaluates city-scale geographical understanding in large multimodal models (VLMs) using real-world videos. Evaluated against the human landmark-route-maps paradigm, we find that current VLMs operate at the Landmark stage. While they can leverage robust semantic matching and visual recognition to simulate spatial awareness, such as reading street signs to “navigate” or brute-forcing frame matches to detect loop closures, they fundamentally fail at path integration and inferring allocentric survey knowledge. When provided with privileged information in context (GPS, maps, or camera poses), they cannot leverage it, suggesting that such capabilities are not yet mature in state-of-the-art models. We hope that our benchmark and analyses will help the community to improve spatial capabilities in VLMs and build reliable AI assistants and embodied AI.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Kilometer Visions,这是第一个使用真实世界视频在大型多式联运模型中全面评估城市规模地理理解的基准。 根据人类地标-路线-地图范式进行评估后,我们发现目前的VLM在Landmark阶段运作. 虽然它们能够利用强健的语义匹配和视觉识别来模拟空间意识,例如读取街道标志以“navigate”或野蛮的强制框架匹配以检测环路关闭,但它们在路径集成时根本失败,并推断出多向心调查知识。 如果在上下文(全球定位系统、地图或相机)中获得特殊信息,它们就无法利用这些信息,说明这种能力在最先进的模型中尚未成熟。 我们希望,我们的基准和分析将有助于社区提高甚高分辨率材料的空间能力,建立可靠的人工智能助手,并体现人工智能。

blocks.en: We introduce KilometerVision , the first benchmark that probes city-scale spatial understanding in large multimodal models (VLMs) from real-world hour-long walking tour videos. We design evaluation tasks taking inspiration from the landmark-task-map framework from the cognitive literature, focusing on landmark recognition, compass, loop closure detection, route summary, and map trace recognition. To efficiently collect annotations for these tasks, we first ground the videos on the map using Google’s public API Visual Positioning Service (VPS). Then, we use simple heuristics together with an additional public API (Google Maps Compute Routes API) to extract the ground-truth annotations with minimal human labelling. We evaluated multiple VLMs across different model families and model sizes.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了Kilometer Vision,这是第一个从真实世界一小时的步行旅游视频中探测大型多式联运模型中城市规模空间理解的基准。 我们从认知文献的里程碑式任务图框架出发,设计评估任务,侧重于里程碑式识别、指南针、环闭探测、路由汇总和地图跟踪识别。 为了高效收集这些任务的说明,我们首先使用Google的公众API视觉定位服务(VPS)将视频在地图上进行定位. 然后,我们用简单的heuristics 加上一个额外的公共API(Google Maps compute Routes API)来提取地面真实性说明,并加上最低限度的人类标签. 我们评估了不同模范家庭和模型大小的多个虚拟模型。

blocks.en: A1 VPS pipeline details
blocks.zh: A1 VPS 管道细节

blocks.en: For any given outdoor image, VPS provides the latitude and longitude of the location where the image was taken, the camera pose, and a confidence score in its prediction. This is done by computing an image embedding and registering it against Google StreetView Image embeddings, retrieving the coordinates of the nearest neighbour image in this embedding space. To obtain good results, VPS needs to be initialised with an approximate location of where the image was taken.
blocks.zh: 对于任何给定的室外图像,VPS提供图像拍摄地点的纬度和经度,相机姿势,以及预测中的信心分数. 这样做的方式是计算一个嵌入的图像并对照Google StreetView图像嵌入进行注册,在此嵌入空间中检索最近邻居图像的坐标. 为了取得良好结果,VPS需要公布图像的大致位置。

blocks.en: A1.1 VPS initialisation
blocks.zh: A1.1 VPS 初始化

blocks.en: We relied on human annotators to extract the (latitude, longitude) coordinates for the start and end position of each video. The raters were instructed to watch the first / last 3 minutes of the video to identify a location they can confidently place on the map. This location was used as initial estimate for querying the VPS API with video frames sampled from the beginning / end of the video at 4 FPS, until the first VPS output with confidence greater than a threshold (set to 0.9) was obtained. This high-confidence location is then used to run VPS on the entire video at 1 FPS (Alg. 1 ). We use a higher FPS for this initial search than for the rest of the video to find a very accurate seed to guide the rest of the VPS run.
blocks.zh: 我们依靠人类的注释器来提取每段视频的始末位置的坐标(纬度,经度)。 测量员们被指示观看视频的第一/最后3分钟,以识别他们可以自信地在地图上放置的位置. 这个位置被用作查询VPS API的初始估计,视频帧从视频的起始/结束在4 FPS中取样,直到获得了第一个置信度超过阈值的VPS输出(设为0.9). 这个高度自信的位置随后被用于运行整个视频的VPS在1 FPS(Alg 1 . 我们使用一个更高的FPS来进行这个初始搜索,比其他视频要高,以找到一个非常精确的种子来指导VPS的其他运行.

blocks.en: A1.2 Running VPS on the entire video
blocks.zh: A1.2 在整个视频中运行 VPS

blocks.en: We run VPS on the entire video at 1 FPS by updating the location estimate with the new VPS return if the confidence exceeds a predefined threshold (Alg. 1 ). If the confidence threshold is not exceeded for more than a predefined max_since_update steps, we set as new seed the most confident location found among the frames processed since the last update. Empirically, we found that the best values for these thresholds are conf_threshold = 0.9 \text{conf\_threshold}=0.9 , max_since_update is set such that the maximum time between updates is 39s.
blocks.zh: 我们以 1 FPS 运行整个视频的 VPS, 如果置信度超过预定阈值( Alg. 1 ), 用新的 VPS 返回来更新位置估计 。 如果置信阈值不超过预定义的 max_ since_ update 步骤, 我们设定为自上次更新以来处理的帧中最自信的位置为新种子 。 经验中,我们发现这些阈值的最佳值是conf_thershold = 0.9\text{conf{threshold {0.9, 最大_since_update的设定是,从更新到更新的最大时间是39s.

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 vps_video
blocks.zh: 算法 1 vps_video

blocks.en: To further improve the VPS predictions, we run VPS over the video both forwards (using the human start annotation to initialise) and backwards (using the human end annotation to initialise) as outlined in Alg. 2 . The (lat, lon) coordinates for each frame are averaged between the two runs using a confidence-weighted average, and a final VPS pass is done independently for each frame, using the averaged (lat, lon) of each frame as initial location.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步改善VPS的预测,我们运行VPS在视频前方(使用Human start address to Once)和后方(使用Human end address to Once)两个部分,如阿尔格概述. 2,每个帧的(纬度,lon)坐标使用置信加权平均值在两个运行间平均,每个帧的最后一个VPS通过独立完成,使用每个帧的平均值(纬度,lon)作为初始位置.

blocks.zh: 算法 2 vps_ 管道

blocks.en: A1.3 Filtering
blocks.zh: A1.3 过滤

blocks.en: Whilst the VPS system is very robust, it can still produce low-confidence and possibly less accurate predictions in some areas, possibly where StreetView has a lower density coverage. We ran some additional filtering steps to remove such outliers, using a combination of confidence thresholding and distance thresholding between neighbouring points, based on the assumption that the person could not have moved by more than a distance threshold between consecutive frames at 1 FPS. To find the best values for these thresholds, we used a set of 10 videos for which the latitude/longitude coordinates were fully annotated by human raters. We define the filtering as a binary classification problem where an incorrectly accepted coordinate is a false positive and an incorrectly rejected point is a false negative . We swept over different thresholds, and we eventually identified the values that result in 100% specificity ( i.e . no false positives) and as high as possible sensitivity ( i.e . the lowest possible false negatives rate). This is a very conservative filtering, where we want to make sure that the points we keep are correct even if we risk throwing away some less confident but correct points. We found that the best approach (as shown in Alg. 3 ) is to first filter with fairly loose thresholds, setting conf_thresh 1 = 0.62 \text{conf\_thresh}_{1}=0.62 and dist_thresh 1 = 2.54 \text{dist\_thresh}_{1}=2.54 metres. We then specify that within a sliding window size of 30s there should be at least 7 points which pass these loose thresholds. Finally, we perform a second set of filters with a tighter confidence threshold, setting conf_thresh 2 = 0.94 \text{conf\_thresh}_{2}=0.94 and dist_thresh 2 = 3.68 \text{dist\_thresh}_{2}=3.68 metres.
blocks.zh: 尽管VPS系统非常强大,但它仍然可以产生低信心,在有些地区可能更不准确的预测,可能街视的密度较低。 我们运行了一些额外的滤波步骤来去除这种离线器,使用相邻点之间的置信阈值和距离阈值的组合,其假设是,一个人在1 FPS的连续帧间移动的距离阈值不得超过一个. 为了找到这些阈值的最佳值,我们使用了一套包含10个视频,其中的纬度/经度坐标被人类评分员充分注解. 我们把过滤定义为一个二进制分类问题,其中错误接受的坐标为假正数,错误拒绝的点为假负数。 我们横扫了不同的阈值,最终我们发现了导致100%特异性(即无假阳性)和尽可能高的灵敏度(即尽可能低的假阴性率)的数值. 这是一个非常保守的过滤,我们希望确保我们保持的点数是正确的,即使我们冒着丢掉一些不那么自信但正确的点数的风险. 我们发现最好的方法是首先使用相当松散的阈值进行过滤,设置conf_thresh 1 = 0.62\text{conf_thresh_1\0.62和dist_thresh 1= 2.54\text{dist_thresh_1\2.54米。 然后我们规定,在30年代的滑动窗口大小范围内,至少应有7个点通过这些松散的阈值。 最后,我们进行第二组滤波器,其置信阈值更紧,设置conf_thresh 2 = 0.94\text{conf_thresh}_{2}=0.94 和 dist_thresh 2 = 3.68\text{dist_thresh}_{2}=3.68米.

blocks.en: A2 DTW-based distance metric between VPS and ground truth
blocks.zh: A2 DTW基于VPS与地面真理之间的距离测量

blocks.en: To validate the overall VPS pipeline, we compared the VPS trajectories against ground-truth trajectories collected by human raters. The ground-truth paths were drawn onto a Google Maps interface as a sequence of contiguous line segments, ranging in length from a meter to hundreds of meters. VPS outputs a sequence of positions, one per video frame. To measure the distance of this position sequence from the ground truth line segments, we linearly subsampled each line segment with points such that subsequent points were no more than 1 meter apart, turning the segment sequence into a position sequence. We then associated points from the VPS trajectory to these subsampled ground-truth points using a variant of dynamic time warping (DTW). DTW provides an index mapping as a sequence of index pairs [ ( i 1 , j 1 ) , ⋯ , ( i K , j K ) ] [(i_{1},j_{1}),\cdots,(i_{K},j_{K})] into sequences A A and B B , such that the sum of distances between corresponding pairs (eq 1 ) is minimised. d ​ i ​ s ​ t ​ ( A , B ) = Σ k ​ ‖ A ⁡ [ i k ] − B ⁡ [ j k ] ‖ dist(A,B)=\Sigma_{k}||A[i_{k}]-B[j_{k}]|| (1) In our setting, the VPS trajectory and the ground-truth trajectory have different sampling rates. The VPS trajectory is sampled at 1 FPS, but some points get removed during the outlier filtering process, which may lead to some gaps. The ground-truth trajectory is sampled such that consecutive points are at less than 1m apart. In standard DTW, a point from the A sequence (VPS trajectory in our case) may match up with several points on the B sequence (human-provided annotations); this happens in our case due to possible gaps in the VPS trajectory, artificially inflating the DTW distance. To prevent this, in our DTW variant, we keep only the closest among all matching points, discarding the remaining matches.

blocks.en: A3.2 Qualitative results
blocks.zh: A3.2 定性结果

blocks.en:
As mentioned in Sec. 5.3 , we include here more qualitative results and/or thinking traces across tasks for Gemini 2.5 Flash and Claude Opus in Figs. 14 , 16 and 15 .
Note that the general approach appears to be correct and human-like, but even a single mistake in inferring either a location or an angle can throw the model off and result in an incorrect final answer.
In the compass question example, Fig. 14 , Gemini misjudges the angle change in a couple of video segments and gives the wrong answer. Claude mistakes the angle at one turn, but manages to recover and outputs the correct answer.
In the Route summary ablation, where the model is aided by a text labelled map trace ( Fig. 15 ), we see the models’ strength in identifying streets and squares and directions relative to these. However, Gemini fails to understand the movement pattern in the first part of the video, causing it to misinterpret the correct option. Claude outputs the correct answer.
Finally, in the landmark question example, Fig. 16 , Gemini relies too much on known landmarks and their incorrectly memorised coordinates, also hallucinating tool use calls. Claude tries to reason about the general location of the landmark and the final location in the video, and ends up underestimating the distance. None of the models try to do path integration.
